searchText: Added reth & erigon to the config 🙂 We have 4 ready ELs & 5 CLs now. Chain looks good: http://167.235.1.185:8081/ So as besu & prysm are still sprinting & erigon fixing bugs, we gonna wait for early next week before spinning up devnet 1. Hey there, quick question, we got a report that there is a problem with communication Grandine <-> EthereumJS. I see that EthereumJS/Grandine is missing slots. Do you see anything wrong there? It seems it has to do with the JWT communication 🙂 ~~Oh wait, it is not active yet it seems~~ -> NVM should be active at genesis Yea, the grandine <> ethereumjs pair is not working properly. It looks like the engine communication doesn't work. All engine requests seems to fail with a 401 response Alright, thanks CC <@425269142615097345> this likely has to do with the JWT report ^ sure that it's jwt related? if the jwt file couldn't be read for either grandine or ethereumjs, it'd affect all pairs with that client? they're all set up the same way, but it only affects one pair It has to do with decoding messages, something to do with padding Or well, thats what the report says Yeah, I would then think it's still not fully clear if it's more of an EthereumJS or a Grandine thing? So just for context, this is this issue: https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/issues/3508 I can reproduce this locally and it has to do with JWT decoding it seems I have fixed and generated image for that one now Fixed it 🙂 https://github.com/ethereumjs/ethereumjs-monorepo/pull/3511 Also tested this locally, it indeed had to do with decoding JWTs 🙂 checked, erigon passes the fork slot now, but gets stuck with the first block containing a deposit request 😉 ``` [WARN] [07-17|11:01:24.117] [rpc] served conn=172.16.0.45:41356 method=engine_newPayloadV4 reqid=98 t=113.796µs err="invalid argument 0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field DepositRequest.depositRequests.pubkey of type [48]uint8" ``` What block number is that? should be triggered at slot 38 / 39. question: Served engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV2 conn=172.16.4.29:39454 reqid=129 duration="38.542µs" err="the method engine_getPayloadBodiesByHashV2 does not exist/is not available" do most els support this for devnet1? ( we are calling this in electra) but running into this error besu on main should be ready, it passes all the exec spec tests. I'm trying to run it in a kurtosis enclave but have run into some kind of bug.... details on the Kurtosis discord. anyway, feel free to add besu to the devnet-1 and let me or <@905058765022310460> know how it breaks what's the branch/image name? still need a few more PRs to merge in, and debugging a few more things, but prysm mainnet preset should be ready in the next day or so? ( develop) minimal will have a temporary solution but attestation packing needs rework before beign too reliable ( temp fix should also be in the next day or so)

excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
Added reth & erigon to the config 🙂 
We have 4 ready ELs & 5 CLs now. Chain looks good: http://167.235.1.185:8081/

So as besu & prysm are still sprinting & erigon fixing bugs, we gonna wait for early next week before spinning up devnet 1.
